scope: 60 supplied English cards for existing notes; resolved through the approved path map. Existing detailed text and PNG pixels are preserved.
review_method: Opened every supplied image at full resolution in a two-card inspection sheet. Read original-paper method, result-table attribution and limitations; cross-checked numeric tokens against the same-revision PDF. Token presence supplements manual dataset/protocol attribution rather than verifying it automatically.

papers.method_review: RGB video enters VGGT; spatial-variance-weighted attention heads produce initial dynamic masks. Radius density filtering and confidence-weighted depth/RGB reprojection residuals refine masks, dynamic points and camera estimates (Sec. 3.2-3.4).
papers.reported_evidence_review: DyCheck Table 1, PDF p7: mean accuracy error 0.0350 for VGGT4D versus 0.0303 for Robust4D-VGT. The source does not establish a metric unit for this column.
papers.qualifications_review: Card explicitly qualifies the training-free claim: Sec. 3.4 modifies a prediction head with another confidence channel. Attention/confidence are proxies; thresholds and sparse structures matter. Illustrations are conceptual.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Three observed views are encoded with a tokenwise adaptive multilevel VAE. Camera-ray-conditioned DiT flow matching completes thirteen virtual-view latents, followed by a fine-tuned one-Euler-step predictor and the adapted AnySplat Gaussian image-embedding head. Virtual cameras interpolate observed camera centers/rotations.
papers.reported_evidence_review: RealEstate10K Table 1, PDF p7: AnySplat with 3 observed views PSNR 22.47; DensiTok with those 3 plus 13 inferred-view tokens 24.28; 16-real-view comparison 24.04.
papers.qualifications_review: Virtual tokens are learned completions, not additional observations. MoGe2 pseudo-depth and separate backbone-specific training qualify geometry/generalization. Geometry encoder remains frozen.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Unposed RGB views enter interleaved local attention and global test-time-training layers. MLP fast weights are updated from key-value virtual objectives and queried by camera raymaps to predict RGB/depth without updating scene memory. Main all-view bidirectional and separately fine-tuned streaming variants are distinguished.
papers.reported_evidence_review: H100 SXM5 Table 7, PDF p14: 750 views require VGGT 200.364 s versus ZipMap 9.999 s, about 20x in this setting; small-view speed does not universally improve.
papers.qualifications_review: Fixed fast-weight size does not imply constant total token/output memory or unlimited sequence accuracy. Novel-view RGB can blur, and reconstruction degrades beyond training scales.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Frozen CUT3R inference produces candidate state; temporal normalized state change and spatial feature dissimilarity times cross-attention form two sigmoid masks. Their product continuously blends old and candidate memory; the first update is retained. No additional learnable parameters or forward pass.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Supplement Table 4 PDF p14: KITTI 512x144, 18.0 FPS and 6 GB; all experiments use one NVIDIA A6000 (PDF p5).
papers.qualifications_review: Long-sequence gains do not imply uniform short-sequence gains. Pose metrics use Sim(3) alignment. Overlap, occlusion and base memory capacity remain constraints; masks are update gates, not motion labels.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Monocular RGB plus external world-frame reconstruction pointmaps are VAE-encoded independently per frame. First-frame geometry latents are duplicated as track queries with paired temporal RoPE; Wan video DiT with LoRA performs one regression pass at timestep zero. Residual displacement plus initial points and a visibility decoder yield dense tracks.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 6 PDF p9: 12 frames, 448x448, A6000: TrackCraft3R 3.91 s / 7.63 GB; DELTAv2 5.00 s / 35.46 GB.
papers.qualifications_review: External depth/pose errors propagate. Longer videos use anchored windows; a single regression pass does not mean real-time video synthesis.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Tracked camera/expression conditions and sparse portraits enter frozen DINOv3 plus alternating-view attention. Cross-attention onto 5,023 FLAME vertices, barycentric UV densification and refinement predict a canonical Gaussian head. FLAME blendshapes/LBS drive animation, with optional motion-aware residual refinement.
papers.reported_evidence_review: VFHQ novel expressions Table 1 PDF p10 and Table S2 p24, eight reference images on RTX 4090D: full PSNR 23.35, creation 2.1 s, animation 31 FPS; fast without refinement 23.20, 2.1 s, 468 FPS.
papers.qualifications_review: Creation time and ongoing animation FPS are distinct. Unseen regions, rear-head and mouth interiors remain ambiguous; tongue is not modeled. Tracking quality and VFHQ demographic imbalance limit robustness.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: RGB frames update a persistent learned state through paired cross-attention decoders. Dense local/shared-frame pointmaps and camera pose are predicted in parallel. A virtual-camera raymap queries the same readout decoder without changing state to infer unseen appearance/geometry.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2 PDF p6: KITTI 512x144, A100, CUT3R 16.58 FPS and per-sequence scale-aligned AbsRel 0.118; MonST3R-GA 0.35 FPS / 0.168.
papers.qualifications_review: Learned metric prediction is not exact scale recovery. Long sequences drift without global refinement, distant virtual queries blur, and unseen geometry is inferred. Mixed supervision and staged recurrent training are required.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Overlapping unposed RGB chunks independently enter VGGT. Confidence filtering and confidence-times-Huber IRLS weighted Umeyama Sim(3) align chunks. DINOv2 place retrieval adds joint loop chunks; a small LM graph optimizes chunk transforms. Disk caching bounds active chunk memory.
papers.reported_evidence_review: PDF p7 Table 2: mean ATE 1.996 m over ten roughly 200-frame Waymo segments. Table 6 p9 KITTI 00 loop ablation 58.69 to 8.67 m. Table 5 reports 2.6-2.8 s per size-75 chunk, excluding disk I/O.
papers.qualifications_review: Sequence-wide retrieval is not strict causal streaming and graph alignment is optimization. Larger chunks require more GPU RAM; sparse Waymo LiDAR limits geometric evaluation. Component runtimes are not end-to-end latency.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Current image/human tokens and frozen CUT3R/Human3R persistent memory provide scene context. Previous-frame point neighborhoods and momentum contact tokens encode local metric geometry and contact history; decoded contact features residually refine human latents before the SMPL-X head.
papers.reported_evidence_review: RICH Table 4 PDF p9: Parallel Readout WA-MPJPE 97.9 mm versus all UniCon3R components 81.5 mm, using the paper-specific global motion protocol.
papers.qualifications_review: Binary contact is not force/friction estimation. No guarantee for deformable supports; upstream scene geometry and pose affect grounding. v2 is the resolved revision of the supplied unversioned source.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Posed RGB views form a MASt3R co-visibility graph and COLMAP triangulated tracks for initial 3DGS. A multiview flow model starts from encoded initial renders, conditions on source images and Plucker rays, and integrates twenty steps. Generated views join real images for a second 3DGS fit with separate losses.
papers.reported_evidence_review: DL3DV140 12-view Table 1 PDF p6: initial PSNR 20.86 / LPIPS 0.333 to FlowR 22.43 / 0.280. This is FlowR, not the separate FlowR++ test-render enhancement.
papers.qualifications_review: Requires posed views and substantial scene fitting; not one-step or pose-free. Camera-path sampling, initial geometry and unobserved areas constrain quality.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Sparse RGB views, camera parameters, edit mask and instruction condition a frozen pi3 geometry backbone. OpenCLIP text enters synchronized decoder layers 1/9/17/25/33 with view reliability weights; a mask-localized residual changes the base pointmap. Paired synthetic DeltaScene edits supervise geometry/preservation/normal/ray-depth losses.
papers.reported_evidence_review: DeltaScene Table 1 PDF p10: Edit3r CLIP 28.9 / C-FID 130.8 versus VGGT-Edit 30.2 / 122.4.
papers.qualifications_review: The card names pi3 rather than implying a VGGT backbone. It flags conflicting latency claims: prose about 2 seconds, Table 1 about 5 seconds. Synthetic editing evidence does not demonstrate physical robot execution.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Camera-rig RGB images are independently ViT-L encoded; last-four-layer features are projected with learned BEV queries and two cross-attention blocks, fused by DPT. Interpolated BEV features and normalized 3D queries decode continuous occupancy. Training uses LiDAR ray free-space/surface samples with balanced BCE; no LiDAR or explicit calibration is needed at inference.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Occ3D-nuScenes binary camera-visible occupancy Table 1 PDF p5: F1 0.7115 / IoU 0.5658. Pointmap evaluation on five driving datasets reports average rank 1.8, not best on every metric.
papers.qualifications_review: All five evaluated dataset domains appear in training. Geometry-only fixed ego ROI; no semantic occupancy or forecasting. Six cameras illustrate nuScenes; source also handles seven-camera Argoverse 2. Camera dropout examples do not guarantee unseen-surface completion.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: One image and text condition CogVideoX joint diffusion over paired RGB and depth-plus-optical-flow VAE latents. RGB VAE and shared temporal DPT with task heads decode video, pointmaps, cameras, scene flow and dynamic masks. Synthetic labels and real-video pseudo-labels train isolated then joint stages with static reprojection/dynamic-flow regularization.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2 PDF p7: generated-video depth log-RMSE GeoVideo 0.353 versus WorldReel 0.287, measured against ViPE pseudo-ground-truth. Settings generate 49 RGB frames and 13 latent-resolution 4D frames (Sec.4.1).
papers.qualifications_review: Finite clips, topology changes, occlusions and fast motion remain difficult. Pseudo-label agreement is not physical ground truth; no persistent unlimited-time guarantee.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Calibrated RGB/ray tokens are normalized to average-camera coordinates and baseline scale. Parallel geometry/appearance streams cross-attend into 2,048 fixed scene latent slots with register tokens. Separate heads decode Gaussians; training merges sixteen candidates per slot through 1/2/4/8 capacity stages, ending at 16,384 Gaussians.
papers.reported_evidence_review: RealEstate10K 12 views at 256x256, Table 1 PDF p10: GlobalSplat16K PSNR 28.57 with about 16K Gaussians versus AnySplat 23.06 with about 1.5M.
papers.qualifications_review: Requires camera calibration and static scenes. Fixed capacity can limit city/unbounded scenes; 2-3 views remain hard. Quality/compactness comparison is not superiority on every perceptual metric.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: VGGT or pi3 RGB features are adapted with attention LoRA. Distractor suppression pushes contaminated features apart; similarity-weighted static cross-view consistency pulls reliable matches together. A supervised mask head filters distracting points at inference without requiring ground-truth masks or 3D annotations.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Unseen NeRF-on-the-go ten sampled views and Umeyama alignment, Table 1 PDF p8: VGGT mean accuracy/completion distance 0.041/0.146 to VGTW(VGGT) 0.033/0.117. Reference geometry is pi3 on clean views, not laser ground truth.
papers.qualifications_review: Static geometry goal; tracking not evaluated. Small mask-labeled training data, uneven depth gains and unresolved occluded geometry qualify claims.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Monocular video feeds pi3 whole-frame geometry and CameraHMR human-crop branches. A two-layer AlignNet queries scene features with HMR/scale tokens to predict global positive scene scale and framewise SMPL translations. Three training stages refine human point surfaces, learn synthetic coarse alignment, then refine AlignNet with visible-surface one-way Chamfer/depth-order/pseudo-keypoint losses.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Bonn Table 1 PDF p6: UniSH depth AbsRel 0.035 / threshold accuracy 0.980 versus pi3 0.049 / 0.975. EMDB-2/RICH use 100-frame aligned motion segments; specialized methods can be more accurate.
papers.qualifications_review: Metric scale is learned from body priors, not guaranteed exact. Nonparametric human floaters and data filtering/demographic coverage remain limitations. Teacher depth and masks are training-only.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Uncalibrated RGB enters frozen DA3 geometry with a trained Gaussian head. Training-only SCPA renders estimated target poses, re-estimates them, reverses drift and selects the lower reconstruction loss. ROM compares student versus teacher multiview geometry, assigning one-sided opacity penalties to excess-error primitives; spatial regularization repairs modest inconsistency.
papers.reported_evidence_review: RE10K 24-view Table 1 PDF p11: DA3 PSNR 21.06 versus AirSplat 23.77. Pose-free NVS benchmarks use test-time target-pose alignment as described in Sec.4.2.
papers.qualifications_review: SCPA and ROM are training modules, not repeated inference requirements. Unseen regions can remain empty; severe motion and scaling to thousands of views remain limitations.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Sparse unposed photos produce complete-graph MASt3R pairwise geometry and camera priors. Global alignment, confidence-ranked depth-consistent duplicate removal and single-camera focal averaging initialize 3D Gaussians and poses. Differentiable Gaussian bundle adjustment jointly optimizes both with confidence-aware point learning rates.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tanks and Temples three-view Table 2 PDF p7, A100: short 200-step 7.5 s / LPIPS 0.1844; XL 1000-step 25.4 s / LPIPS 0.1634.
papers.qualifications_review: SfM-free but not optimization-free. Held-out camera poses receive 500 separate optimization iterations with frozen scene. Training time is not capture-to-result latency; hundreds-view alignment, focal assumptions and limited overlap constrain performance.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Monocular RGB plus external DepthPro or DepthAnythingV2 depth enters dual streams. Unprojected axis-normalized pointmaps use a new ViT and zero-initialized injections at DUSt3R decoder layers. Frozen RGB encoder and fine-tuned decoder/depth transformer predict pairs; flow-aided graph optimization and 10/20-frame keyframe/local hierarchy align long videos.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Bonn thirty-frame M=10 Table 5 PDF p8: without hierarchy 2.9 min / 24.0 GB / AbsRel 0.054 versus with hierarchy 1.1 min / 5.9 GB / 0.056.
papers.qualifications_review: External depth and iterative alignment are required. Evaluation uses per-sequence scale/shift alignment; no absolute metric guarantee. Synthetic training filters depth beyond 400 m and can lose detail in simple indoor cases.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Monocular video first undergoes VLM/SAM3 parsing, MoGe-3 metric geometry, WiLoR MANO and generated multiview canonical-object reconstruction with enhanced FoundationPose. Structured hand/object states enter conditional bridge flow matching; temporal DiT attends to PointTransformerV3 geometry and ray-conditioned frozen DINOv2 features, with late silhouette/contact/temporal guidance.
papers.reported_evidence_review: HO3D-v3 eighteen sequences Table 1 PDF p7: hand-relative Chamfer 5.98 cm2, contact accuracy 97.27%, completion 100%; Table 3 p8 for 200 frames: about 23 min preprocessing plus 1 min refinement, about 24 min total. Both evaluation datasets excluded from training.
papers.qualifications_review: Single-hand rigid-object scope. MoGe depth/scale and canonical mesh failures can be catastrophic. Other methods can score better on some hand/object metrics; completion does not prove perfect geometry. Training pairs perturb ground-truth states, not foundation-model outputs.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Four posed head portraits and target expression code enter a transformer. DUSt3R position/confidence and Sapiens features provide geometry/semantics; cross-view self-attention and expression cross-attention predict per-pixel Gaussian attributes. Source position/RGB skips and confidence filtering retain useful primitives without a fixed mesh anchor.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Ava256 held-out subjects, Table 1 PDF p7: PSNR 20.7 dB versus GPAvatar 19.4; evaluation follows the 512x512 setup.
papers.qualifications_review: Pose errors propagate, illumination is baked in, and single-image use requires separate 3D-GAN lifting. Four-view and cross-expression input should not be confused with unposed single-image reconstruction.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: A low-resolution primitive network predicts a compact planar 2DGS grid with high-resolution rendering supervision. A separate texture network combines image patches, primitive features and inverse-projected source RGB to predict per-splat color/alpha textures. Ray-plane sampling adds texture to SH base color and replaces Gaussian falloff with alpha texture; staged joint training reduces primitive learning rate.
papers.reported_evidence_review: DL3DV Table 3 PDF p7: single-view Flash3D, 4096x2304 renders, unchanged 512x288 grid: 2DGS LPIPS 0.371 / PSNR 20.322 versus 8x8-textured LGTM 0.219 / 21.778.
papers.qualifications_review: Geometry/alignment still limits quality and texture size is manual. Four-view VGGT variant was tested through 2K because 4K exceeds memory; no per-scene optimization does not imply unlimited resolution.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Underwater multiview RGB enters shared pi3-style geometry features with DPT point/camera heads. A residual image-restoration branch and register-token water head predict clean image, attenuation, backscatter and background light. A differentiable underwater imaging cycle supplements synthetic RGB-D/pose supervision, then real-video clean-view warping adapts without ground-truth depth.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 PDF p7, real FLSea-Canyons/SQUID scale-only aligned depth: pi3 AbsRel 0.0891/0.1959 versus WAT3R 0.0725/0.1486. USOD10K monocular evaluation uses DPT pseudo-depth.
papers.qualifications_review: Ground-truth-free applies to real-data adaptation, not synthetic supervision. Simplified water model, sim-to-real gap, scale drift, uneven pose gains and extreme turbidity remain; aligned errors are not absolute metric accuracy.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: RGB plus any subset of depth, rays/intrinsics, poses and simulated Doppler are summed as normalized per-view tokens. MapAnything-initialized alternating attention jointly decodes local rays/depth, camera poses, first-frame-to-target allocentric motion and a shared positive metric scale. Mixed static/dynamic supervision and modality dropout support flexible inputs.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 PDF p7: 50-frame runtime 0.50 s on H100. Synthetic Kubric/VKITTI dense flow and real/synthetic sparse tracking use specific dynamic-point protocols; tracking additionally uses median scale alignment.
papers.qualifications_review: Reference points must be visible initially. Doppler is simulated radial egocentric flow, not validated real radar. Perfect sensor assumptions, dominant motion/poor overlap and learned global scale error remain; not persistent SLAM.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: YoNoSplat predicts initial cameras/Gaussians. Three shared-weight iterations render context RGB/depth, encode 13-channel RGB residual/render/Plucker-ray/depth features with coarse and fine convolution branches, lift blended multiview features to Gaussians, and predict position/opacity/color deltas. Cameras, rotations and scales stay fixed; training differentiates through all iterations.
papers.reported_evidence_review: DL3DV 140-scene test, six views, 224x224, Table 1 PDF p6: predicted poses with known intrinsics PSNR 26.64 versus YoNoSplat 24.89; fully uncalibrated DeltaSplat 25.69.
papers.qualifications_review: No gradient-based test-time scene refinement, but learned iterative passes are required. Target camera photometric alignment is used for evaluation; higher resolutions and other backbones are future work.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Ordered overlapping RGB frames query previous-frame spatial memory. Target/reference cross-attention decoders and point/Gaussian heads predict first-camera-frame geometry and appearance; full recent and attention-ranked sparse long-term memory retain context. Per-frame Gaussians accumulate by union and render without intermediate camera estimation/global alignment.
papers.reported_evidence_review: ScanNet++ ten validation scenes Table 1 PDF p6, H100, fifty inputs: PSNR 20.38 and total reported runtime 2.265 s, about 20 reconstruction FPS. Roughly 200 FPS rasterizer rendering is a separate measure.
papers.qualifications_review: Weak-overlap transitions damage following frames. Trained at 224x224 mainly in single rooms with selected reliable-scale datasets; outdoor/multi-room generalization remains limited.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Two frozen DUSt3R/MonST3R passes: first aggregates decoder attention spatial/temporal means and variances into dynamic masks; second masks only dynamic-source-to-static-reference attention in the reference decoder, retaining source-decoder access to all reference tokens. Segmentation-aware global alignment optimizes world points/poses/scales with optional static optical-flow reprojection.
papers.reported_evidence_review: DAVIS16 Table 1 PDF p6 without SAM2: flow-guided DUSt3R baseline mean IoU 42.1 versus no-flow Easi3R-DUSt3R 53.1. This is segmentation overlap, not success rate.
papers.qualifications_review: Training-free means no weight finetuning, not optimization-free or one-pass. Backbone depth errors and boundary floaters remain. SAM2 and flow are separate optional enhancements.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Paired dynamic frames use a frozen DUSt3R encoder with finetuned decoders/heads. Ground-truth or teacher optical flow, forward-backward occlusion and camera-induced motion construct supervision aligning static and visible dynamic points into the first view camera and temporal state. DPT mask and cross-attention-based RAFT-style flow heads add explicit outputs.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 5 PDF p8, KITTI 2D correspondence EPE: D2USt3R without flow head 8.91 pixels versus with flow head 3.57. Bonn affine-invariant depth comparison in Table 2 uses MonST3R reproduced on matched training data.
papers.qualifications_review: Flow/mask supervision is training-only. Occlusion excludes unavailable targets; no hidden geometry recovery. Pairwise model, shared scale-normalized coordinates and mixed dataset results do not establish persistent metric 4D mapping.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Eight calibrated views each supply black-field, white-field and patterned observations. Image plus camera-ray tokens enter Mamba2/Transformer encoding; separate heads predict Gaussian geometry and albedo/roughness/ambient color. Rasterized attribute buffers map surface points into the calibrated projector and shade sampled patterns with a dielectric BRDF.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Synthetic Table 1 PDF p8: 35.76 dB PSNR, 0.13 s Gaussian prediction plus rendering on RTX 3090, 128x128. Real tests qualitatively evaluate fifteen held-out objects after finetuning on twenty-five.
papers.qualifications_review: Fixed calibrated acquisition poses and eight-view setup; very sparse views degrade. Real material parameter accuracy is not directly measured, and results do not demonstrate arbitrary high-resolution projection mapping.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Uncalibrated multiview RGB supplies VGGT geometry, DINOv3 semantics and high-resolution CNN texture. Modified multiscale DPT heads fuse geometry/semantics and inject pixel-aligned texture late, predict camera-local Gaussians, then transform with predicted cameras. Source-only Gaussian features are separated from mixed source/target camera estimation and rotation/scale/translation alignment.
papers.reported_evidence_review: DL3DV 256x256, no post-optimization Table 1 PDF p10: StructSplat PSNR 28.045 versus AnySplat 22.377 in the no-camera-parameters category.
papers.qualifications_review: Target images still participate in target-camera alignment, not Gaussian feature extraction. Sparse views, occlusion and complex view-dependent lighting remain difficult.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Unposed driving RGB enters frozen DINO and alternating attention, with Gaussian/lifespan/dynamic heads and a frozen camera head. Static Gaussians aggregate over frames; current dynamic Gaussians move using predicted pairwise 3D displacements with linear mean interpolation and camera SLERP. Separate sky Gaussians and post-render one-step diffusion improve rendered images.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Waymo Table 1 PDF p6: DGGT PSNR 27.41 / SSIM 0.846 versus STORM 26.38 / 0.794. Appendix protocol uses three cameras, observed times 0/5/10/15 and target times 0-19 on A100.
papers.qualifications_review: Training uses Waymo LiDAR boxes/tracks/masks; pose-free is not annotation-free. Linear interpolation is not a continuous nonlinear trajectory guarantee. Diffusion repairs appearance, not underlying geometry; no autonomous-driving safety validation.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Monocular egocentric RGB uses frozen VGGT-Omega/DINOv3 features and learned root/joint/surface hand queries. Dense hand observations exchange gated context bidirectionally with sparse scene anchors. Explicit root-relative points and visibility/contact/distance heads, ray-constrained root recovery, learned scene scale and hand-depth scale refinement place hands in world space.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Held-out OakInk-v2/TACO/HOI4D raw MPJPE Table 1 PDF p7: 51.81/54.64/47.28 mm. H20 Fig.8 PDF p9: 28.69 hand-observation FPS at 512x512 versus WiLoR 4.81; 85.95 dense output FPS includes 3x interpolation.
papers.qualifications_review: Offline bidirectional context, interpolation and clip-scale stitching are outside the network. World/aligned protocols and GT-camera baselines cannot be mixed for ranking. Contact does not identify partner; 18/14 mm labels differ from 2 mm baseline conventions. 195-to-778 mesh interpolation can degrade contact.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Masked uncalibrated object views enter jointly trained VGGT geometry and UNet appearance branches. Gaussian queries start near the optical-axis-intersection center. Each decoder layer projects centers into all views, deformably samples fused features and refines attributes; geometry/depth consistency and rendered RGB train the system jointly.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Four-view GSO Table 2 PDF p9: FlexSplat PSNR 29.73 versus posed UniGS 30.42, while perceptual score is competitive. Budgets are 10K/15K/20K Gaussians for 1/2/4 views, independent of image resolution.
papers.qualifications_review: Object-centric evaluation and global similarity alignment qualify NVS scores. Very large camera/depth errors propagate; no scene-scale evaluation or universal PSNR advantage.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: MASt3R-initialized encoder feeds asymmetric image/camera token streams. Directionally constrained decoder attention separates scene and pose cues; coarse token locations and confidence support spatial, softmax-weighted fusion before multiscale Gaussian decoding with relative offsets. Pose MSE/dual-quaternion and RGB/LPIPS losses train jointly.
papers.reported_evidence_review: RE10K eight-view Table 1 PDF p6: TokenSplat PSNR 26.15 versus SPFSplat 25.18. ScanNet 28-view Table 2: 26.87 after ten-view training; removing known intrinsic embedding Table 5 reduces RE10K PSNR to 25.54.
papers.qualifications_review: Pose-free is not calibration-free: main model uses known intrinsics. The reported larger-view test is 28 views, not evidence of unbounded scaling.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Already globally aligned 4D tracks, visibility, camera centers and external metric anchor positions enter a nonlearned correction. Static filtering, unit-velocity agreement in spatial kNN graphs and split/merge form motion groups. Five-percent sparse anchors estimate per-frame median radial scales plus one constant group translation, with interpolation and degenerate-group fallbacks.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Synthetic PointOdyssey DQS protocol, five-percent GT anchors, Table 2 PDF p7: OpenD4RT (source label D4RT) EPE 0.1812 to 0.1269, relative reduction 29.9%. All query points including anchors enter primary evaluation.
papers.qualifications_review: Not RGB-only scale recovery. Experiments use GT camera centers and anchors; noisy anchors erode gains. Approximate rigid groups, global alignment and radial correction family constrain applicability; static-background Full results can worsen.

papers.method_review: Pinhole/fisheye/spherical RGB plus supplied camera type enter pretrained DINO/pi3 features. Camera-type-conditioned spherical-harmonic angular module predicts unit rays; radial module predicts distance/uncertainty, and pose head supplies transforms to world space. All modules train end-to-end with shared sequence-scale geometry and camera augmentation.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Zero-shot wide-FOV Table 2 PDF p10: AUC@30 Zip-NeRF 74.61 versus original pi3 40.94; Stanford2D3D 79.93 versus 2.06. Matched-data pi3 exceeds Wid3R on FIORD 72.56 versus 68.20.
papers.qualifications_review: Unknown shared scale and camera-type requirement remain. No explicit dynamics; multi-view memory and panorama generation remain limited/future work. Point geometry is aligned for evaluation, not proof of metric scale or photorealistic view synthesis.

papers.method_review: Unposed context images enter a VGGT/DINOv2 geometry branch predicting cameras and fixed Gaussian geometry. A separate reference DINOv2 appearance encoder supplies global CLS modulation with AdaLN-Zero and local cross-attention; SH color changes without geometry deformation. Overlap-guided view selection and joint multi-reference supervision learn appearance control.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Phototourism twelve context views Table 2 PDF p9: WildSplat PSNR 21.47 / LPIPS 0.137 versus AnySplat 18.00 / 0.228. Target left half supplies reference appearance; metrics use right half; target poses are optimized with Gaussians frozen.
papers.qualifications_review: Reference-controlled learned appearance is not physical relighting. Local projected illumination can blend/miss; dense prediction and attention scale memory with views/resolution.

papers.method_review: Synchronized uncalibrated multiview snapshot enters VGGT geometry and confidence-weighted continuous 3D feature aggregation. Gaussian/human-confidence decoding selects tokens for visible reprojection of ROMP pose, DINOv3 appearance and VGGT features. Intra/cross-view and 3D contrastive embeddings separate people; confidence-weighted person pooling regresses SMPL.
papers.reported_evidence_review: REAL EgoHumans severe occlusion, Table 2 PDF p17: HSfM CA/GA/PA-MPJPE 1.18/0.53/0.13 m versus proposed 0.89/0.28/0.14 m. PA-MPJPE does not improve in this slice.
papers.qualifications_review: Static multiview only, not temporal tracking. Geometry initialization errors and difficult viewpoint/depth boundaries propagate. Memory is not necessarily lower than optimization baselines.

papers.method_review: Monocular video conditions pretrained DynamiCrafter geometry diffusion via local VAE and global CLIP/query-transformer streams. Five DDIM steps predict clip-first-frame pointmaps with uncertainty, disparity and Plucker rays. Overlapping sixteen-frame clips at stride four undergo point/scale-shift disparity/ray-camera joint global alignment with temporal regularization.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 PDF p6 sequence-scale-and-shift aligned AbsRel Sintel/Bonn/KITTI 0.205/0.059/0.086. TUM dynamics Table 2 p7: RPE rotation 0.635 versus MonST3R 1.217, but ATE 0.073 versus 0.063 is higher.
papers.qualifications_review: Iterative diffusion and global optimization, not one forward pass or real time. Unknown global scale, stochastic output, VAE bottleneck, extreme camera motion/focal changes and monocular-only temporal architecture remain.

papers.method_review: Unposed RGB views enter shared VGGT geometry tokens and DPT geometry/Gaussian/semantic/instance heads. Training distills text-aligned LSeg and SAM masks; Sem2Ins fuses semantic/instance predictions and Ins2Sem regularizes semantic agreement among instance-similar Gaussians. CLIP text queries and HDBSCAN cluster predicted features to render semantic/instance labels.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Eight-view novel-view panoptic quality Table 3 PDF p7: ScanNet 0.5304 versus Uni3R+Unified-Lift 0.4013; Replica 0.3539 versus 0.2716.
papers.qualifications_review: 2D teachers are training supervision, not inference inputs. Feed-forward reconstruction still uses clustering for instance masks. Static indoor training/domain limits; rendered panoptic scores are not robot success rates.

papers.method_review: Monocular RGB enters a VGGT-based geometry transformer with camera attention supervised to favor static background. Training masks come from SAM2 regions and SEA-RAFT versus ground-truth camera-induced flow. Frame-grouped causal attention with KV cache streams frames; duplicated camera queries subsequently attend over the completed sequence for post-hoc BA-like attention refinement.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sintel synthetic Sim(3)-aligned ATE Table 1 PDF p6: full-attention VGGT 0.1715 to MoRe 0.0877; streaming Stream3R 0.2144 to MoRe 0.1474. TUM dynamics depth Table 2 p8 worsens 0.151 to 0.173. Window-five KITTI throughput Table 5 p13 is 30.09 FPS.
papers.qualifications_review: Separate full-attention/streaming variants and post-sequence refinement from strict online processing. Noisy training masks, finite windows, fast/nonrigid motion, blur, occlusion and changing appearance remain.

papers.method_review: RGB streams enter frozen CUT3R and Multi-HMR ViT encoders. Patch head detections sample both features into trainable human prompts, which interact with frozen recurrent scene decoders. Heads predict SMPL-X bodies, scene pointmaps, human masks, poses and intrinsics; token-based Sinkhorn/dustbin matching tracks identities. TTT3R adaptive updates and periodic reset alignment handle longer streams.
papers.reported_evidence_review: EMDB-2 largest ViT-L/896 Table 2 PDF p7: W-MPJPE 267.9 mm, WA-MPJPE 112.2 mm, RTE 2.2%; WHAM W-MPJPE 354.8 and offline JOSH 174.7. Appendix A.4: separate lightweight 13.59-15.87 FPS and largest 5.06-5.38 on RTX4090.
papers.qualifications_review: Cannot combine largest-model accuracy with lightweight speed. Evaluation uses 100-frame alignment segments. Head occlusion/collision, missing body regions, interpenetration, clothing and moving nonhuman objects remain. Crowded scenes above benchmark counts are qualitative.

papers.method_review: Unposed RGB enters shared VGGT-initialized geometry and Gaussian decoders with compact eight-dimensional instance features. Gauge-aligned self-rendering and instance supervision learn consistent groups; HDBSCAN groups features, and frozen LSeg pools 512D semantic prototypes per group. A separate scene-graph retrieval and Qwen3-VL reasoning stage selects referred instances.
papers.reported_evidence_review: ScanNet two-input novel-view Table I PDF p6: GroupForward mIoU 0.5989 / PSNR 26.23 versus Uni3R 0.5584 / 25.53. Separate referring segmentation Table IV mIoU 0.6496 with RSRF.
papers.qualifications_review: Inference still needs HDBSCAN and frozen 2D semantics. Default instance training is supervised; SAM2 pseudo-labels are an ablation. Reasoning selects reconstructed/retrieved candidates; indoor datasets and candidate quality limit transfer.

papers.method_review: Uncalibrated video collections use a DA3-based transformer with timestamps to recover depth/rays/world points. Top-twenty-percent dynamic tokens expand across observation times and cross-attend to all image tokens, predicting sparse rotation/translation bases. A deformable DPT head uses temporal mean/variance/max and motion scores to blend bases; dynamic gating leaves background static.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Synthetic custom UE disjoint-video all-frame foreground EPE Table 1 PDF p10: VDPM 0.345 versus OmniX 0.113. Real ADT EPE 0.162 to 0.134 but PStudio 0.141 to 0.156 worsens. Table 5 p14: sixteen-frame sparse model 2.15 s / 21999 MB versus dense 4.10 s / 23727 MB.
papers.qualifications_review: Any-time means input observation times, not demonstrated unlimited continuous sequences. Formal tests use sixteen-frame clips and different training data; memory remains substantial.

papers.method_review: Two RGB frames are processed by DUSt3R with two additional cross-time point/confidence heads, yielding four maps in camera-one coordinates. Equal-time maps establish dense correspondence, within-source time differences give object flow, and rigid Umeyama recovers object motion. Mixed datasets supervise available maps with shared scale-normalized confidence regression.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 3 PDF p7: synthetic Kubric-F object rotation error 33.7 degrees versus MonST3R+RAFT 56.1. Two-view KITTI/Bonn depth gains are selective; video depth is separately fused by bundle adjustment without optical-flow loss.
papers.qualifications_review: Pairwise predictions are up to scale, not persistent metric tracking. Video-depth fusion still optimizes; rigid object pose needs a mask. Large rotation/occlusion remain ambiguous and cross-time extrapolation is inferred.

papers.method_review: Two unposed RGB views with known intrinsics feed NoPoSplat-initialized geometry and a Siamese semantic grouping transformer. Learned pattern queries form Gaussian group weights; pretrained LSeg features are group-pooled and refined into a shared dictionary. Per-Gaussian mixtures render scalar weights before combining dictionary atoms into semantic features. SAM/SAM2 and CLIP collect training labels offline.
papers.reported_evidence_review: ScanNet target views Table 1 PDF p6: ScanNet-trained mIoU 0.7416 versus RE10K-trained zero-shot 0.6265; both target PSNR 24.80. Table 5 total two-view time 180 ms includes LSeg, encoder, grouping, aggregation and Gaussian decoder.
papers.qualifications_review: LSeg semantic features are an inference dependency; offline label collection is distinct. Known intrinsics, tiny/thin objects, reflections, fine-grained category ambiguity and untested dynamics qualify scope.

papers.method_review: MonST3R-initialized DUSt3R predicts observed view-one/view-two points and matched earlier-time positions for view-two pixels. The latter discrepancy yields masks at three times median magnitude. Two temporal attention blocks in low-resolution DPT features train on twelve-frame windows with frozen encoder/decoder. Task-specific pairings produce depth/tracks/window clouds; camera evaluation separately globally aligns masked static geometry.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Twelve-frame tracking Table 2 PDF p7: real ADT APD MonST3R 28.30 versus POMATO 31.57; synthetic PointOdyssey 27.31 versus 33.20. PStudio SpatialTracker 30.41 exceeds POMATO 24.59.
papers.qualifications_review: Bidirectional windowed context and four-frame overlaps do not establish unlimited online operation. Tracking can be ambiguous under occlusion; camera benchmark still optimizes, and no universal pose/metric superiority is claimed.

papers.method_review: Sequential RGB uses frozen CUT3R. Proposed multilayer self-attention motion scores inject additive biases into early layers 0-6 for image self-attention and image/state cross-attention; later geometric layers remain unchanged. Standard point/confidence/pose heads run in parallel.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 PDF p7 real Bonn metric AbsRel CUT3R 0.103 to MUT3R 0.086; ADT Sim(3)-aligned ATE Table 2 0.084 to 0.058. Sintel scale-aligned depth and KITTI metric depth are worse; gains are dataset-specific.
papers.qualifications_review: Card explicitly records algebraic caveat: the printed average over all keys of row-softmax is constant, and a per-query constant bias cancels in softmax. Intended motion extraction/image-query gating needs implementation clarification; benchmark numbers do not prove those equations. No new training, external flow, explicit object trajectories or established overhead.

papers.method_review: RGB-only streams enter pretrained CUT3R geometry, CropFormer masks and DINOv3 features. Mask-pooled spatial/semantic queries are attention-refined with historical context. Sparse reconstructed keys rasterize a query index map; intra-frame merges and cross-frame matching combine query cosine, state-attention distribution cosine and 3D-box IoU. FastSAM masks and Gram spatial-semantic distillation train refinement.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Class-agnostic AP Table 1 PDF p6: ScanNet200 16.7 versus OnlineAnySeg-M 13.4; SceneNN 14.3 versus 13.2. Appendix B.1 p12 A6000: full 321 ms/frame about 3.1 FPS, including 66 ms CUT3R, 55 ms segmentation, 200 ms CropFormer.
papers.qualifications_review: Zero-shot means no ground-truth 3D instance masks, not untrained modules. Merged masks are scored on GT point clouds. Indoor domains, geometry/mask errors and growing memory/association cost remain.

papers.method_review: Internet VR180 stereo videos undergo shot selection, wide-FOV SfM/bundle adjustment, rectification/RAFT stereo depth and BootsTAP 2D tracks. Unprojected 3D tracks are optimized only along camera rays with static, dynamic acceleration and disparity regularization, then filtered. DynaDUSt3R separately learns two-frame pointmaps and query-time-conditioned motion from mined data.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Real ADT, same DynaDUSt3R architecture Table 1 PDF p7: synthetic PointOdyssey training EPE3D 0.3126 m / within-five-cm 8.56%, versus Stereo4D training 0.1231 m / 51.98%. Median-scale alignment and pairs under thirty frames apart qualify evaluation.
papers.qualifications_review: Nominal 6.3 cm stereo baseline produces noisy pseudo-metric labels, not pristine GT. SfM/flow/tracker/occlusion errors remain; learned two-frame model is not a long-video tracker and has unknown output scale before evaluation alignment.

papers.method_review: Single-image, sparse-frame or full-video conditions are packed into zero-filled masked RGB video. Frozen Wan2.1-Fun14B parameters serve two disjoint RGB/XYZ branches with separate rank64 LoRA and sparse bidirectional zero-initialized links. Fifty flow steps and VAE decoding produce synchronized RGB/pointmaps; explicit global optimization derives cameras/depth.
papers.reported_evidence_review: VBench Table 2 PDF p6 dynamic score 55.7% versus 4DNeX 25.6%, I2V consistency 97.8% versus 98.7%. Full-video Sintel/Bonn AbsRel Table 3 p7 0.273/0.092; teacher Geo4D-ref 0.205/0.059. User preference is subjective, not geometry error.
papers.qualifications_review: Generation is inferred unseen content. Iterative runtime, pseudo-label noise, sparse-observation degradation and post-optimization remain. Shared frozen base still has 935.7M trainable parameters; normalized first-frame XYZ is not metric scale.

papers.method_review: Unordered unposed RGB uses frozen DINOv2 semantic and MUSt3R encoder/decoder geometry features. Projected concatenated tokens and shared instance queries cross-attend across views to predict consistent masks and open-vocabulary class embeddings. QUBO maximizes coverage with overlap penalties and simulated annealing. Optional novel-view route uses separately optimized 3DGS and LUDVIG one-hot label lifting.
papers.reported_evidence_review: ScanNet++ validation novel-view Table 3 PDF p8: full PanSt3R PQ 49.1, plus LUDVIG 54.7, versus PanLift 29.5. Novel-view results depend on rendered RGB or optimized Gaussians/cameras.
papers.qualifications_review: Direct supplied-view prediction does not require supplied cameras, while the optional scene route does. Supervised mixed datasets, finite shared-query budget, keyframe selection and approximate mask optimization qualify claims.

papers.method_review: Calibrated multiview RGB, poses/intrinsics and tracked 3D boxes update global scene tokens. The nearest 3,600 frustum tokens transform into current-camera coordinates and enter a twelve-layer multimodal transformer to refine/add tokens while preserving others. Box assignments drive object transforms; Gaussian lifespan, sky MLP and camera-affine heads model appearance/dynamics.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Real Waymo sixteen-second zero-shot length Table 1 PDF p7, trained through eight seconds: UFO PSNR 27.04 / SSIM 0.8162 / depth RMSE 5.08 versus STORM 22.02 / 0.614 / 7.91.
papers.qualifications_review: Inference updates need no rendering/backpropagation but use cameras/boxes. Training uses LiDAR depth unlike depth-disabled per-scene baselines. Scene memory still grows; H20 scaling timing excludes Gaussian rendering and is not end-to-end driving simulation or safety evidence.

papers.method_review: After RGB warmup, main CUT3R RGB/ray inference and a geometry-only ray query decode the same unchanged previous memory. Relative depth discrepancies are confidence/cross-attention aggregated into robust median/IQR staticness weights, temporally averaged to gate memory updates. Repeated boundary frames align reset segments via weighted Sim3; state-aware causal translation smoothing reduces jitter.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 4 PDF p13, RTX A6000, 1000 views: RayMap3R 13.8 FPS / 9.4 GB versus CUT3R 19.7 / 6.5. Table 6 p14: 108 sequences mean motion AUC 0.532 / IoU 0.203; Sintel AUC 0.464 is below chance.
papers.qualifications_review: RayMap stores origin and unit direction, not Plucker moment. Motion cues are soft gates, not precise segmentation. Static memory bias/learned scale/reset alignment matter; slower and larger than CUT3R, no global SLAM or universal best-depth claim.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Sparse/unordered RGB enters frozen VGGT-Omega1B with trainable LoRA. Global learned queries jointly decode persistent masks over all observations using supervised set prediction; optional point/box queries read learned queries in one direction only, preserving prompt-free discovery. Teacher densification fills partial data. Separate iterative Qwen3-VL grounder/critic Active Tree Search handles language.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Full312-scene ScanNet200 RGB-only Table 4 PDF p11: T-mIoU 0.517 versus IGGT4D 0.488. DAVIS prompt-free Table 2 p10 J&F 0.803, no first-frame GT. Segmenter latency 10.1 s per100 observations on A10080GB excludes language harness.
papers.qualifications_review: Video 4D metrics lift predicted and annotated masks through the same estimated geometry, not independent 4D GT. Joint resolution/memory, small similar targets, rapid motion, occlusion and re-entry remain. 4D is persistent identities over observations, not prediction of future scenes.

papers.method_review: Frozen VGGT first predicts features/depth/poses. Layer-specific QQ/KK Gram and QK statistics across neighboring frames combine semantic, motion-instability and spatial cues; feature clustering/Otsu forms masks. Projection-depth-gradient and photometric scores refine clustered points. A rerun suppresses only dynamic keys in layers1-5, keeping deeper geometry layers normal.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Real DyCheck Table 6 PDF p8: early-mask ATE 0.0106 versus VGGT 0.0131 and full-layer mask 0.0302. DAVIS16 mask refinement raises mean IoU 59.74 to62.12 in Table5; these are segmentation/reconstruction metrics, not success rates.
papers.qualifications_review: Training-free includes extra Gram computation, refinement and rerun. Depth errors and nonrigid/fluid motion remain. FastVGGT long-sequence implementation saves selected outputs and computes Gram in place; synthetic500-frame evidence is not unlimited streaming.

papers.method_review: Offline100-frame RGB windows use VGGT-Omega and Multi-HMR with small LoRA adapters. A pelvis readout anchors metric bodies via estimated scene depth; camera/register-token scale readout scales scene/cameras without body dimensions. Layer13 identity descriptors, metric motion and proposal confidence feed dustbin Sinkhorn/Hungarian tracking. Overlapping windows compose closed-form camera similarities with aggregate-scale normalization.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Real EMDB Table1 PDF p7-8: WA-MPJPE66.3 mm, W-MPJPE193.6 mm, RTE0.9%; JOSH68.9/174.7/1.3. WA uses similarity alignment, W first-two-frame alignment, RTE rigid alignment preserving scale.
papers.qualifications_review: Training-only ViTPose++/4DHumans ruler agreement is consistency, not absolute truth; exact metric RICH/3DPW adaptation follows. No visible person/ruler needed at inference. Track loss/re-entry, stair penetration about9cm median, demographic priors and aligned evaluation limit universal scale/accuracy claims.

papers.method_review: Paired RGB and world-XYZ pointmaps from supplied depth/calibration are patch-embedded with FG-CLIP initialization and summed before ViT-B16. View CLS tokens and mean scene embedding train with Chamfer-rank geometry, grounded-object view, view-caption and scene-caption alignments. Text retrieval/classification and a task-trained language/QA head use these representations.

papers.qualifications_review: Viewpoint grounding ranks the view with largest visible object area, not a 3D box. Supplied depth/cameras, fixed224resolution and6,562indoor-scene pretraining remain; VQA requires task adaptation and metrics are not robot success.

papers.method_review: RGB plus pruning fraction beta enters MASt3R/VGGT geometry. Per-pixel DWT high-frequency energy aggregates onto XYZ/RGB K-means SuperClusters. The Figure4/intended pruning description prioritizes low-energy regions while keeping top-ten-percent points and high-energy regions; a binary-mask-conditioned DPT head adapts retained Gaussian attributes. Random budgets train with rendering MSE/LPIPS.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Real RE10K Table1 PDF p11: beta0.4 retains60%, PSNR22.294; beta0.8 retains20%, PSNR20.740. Table3 adaptive-head ablation at40% pruning full22.29 versus without head19.81.
papers.qualifications_review: Texture is a proxy: specular/high-frequency local patches can mislead at high pruning. Backbone errors and quality loss remain; rendering savings need not accelerate backbone. The paper Figure4 description and Sec3.2 budget/index equations leave an allocation ambiguity, explicitly noted beside the preserved card.

Section 3.2’s budget/index equations do not fully specify the same allocation; an exact implementation of that pruning rule requires clarification. The supplied PNG is preserved unchanged.

papers.method_review: Two unposed RGB views enter NAS3R masked geometry attention: context tokens never read target tokens, while target-camera estimation may use both. Gaussian depth/geometry and cameras are predicted; observed RGB analytically fixes DC color. Higher-order SH head combines Gaussian-to-camera unit direction/log-distance, bilinearly warped neighboring color/validity and geometry features.

RGB DC only approximates view-independent color; warping lacks occlusion test and relies on predicted geometry. Two-view evidence does not establish N-view scaling or metric geometry.
